title: Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater arrives on PlayStation 2
summary: In 2004, Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.

blocks.text: In 2004, Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.
In the action and adventure category, Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater broadened the PlayStation 2 library and reflects the range of experiences available during the console's long commercial life.
